title: 第17章 惊神刺 下第18章 刘信晚点还有一章
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
此时林江月的识海中的嫩芽不停抖动，碎片化的记忆不断涌现。
一群蒙面的黑衣修士闯进沐府杀虐抢夺，天空炸响惊雷劈断院中古树，古树燃起烈火，火势从树干蔓延到树梢，又沿着走廊柱子烧到主屋。
一个黑衣女修手拿锁链双剑在空中盘旋。
一名白衣修士冲进火海救出沐家小姐，黑衣女修紧追不舍，空中火花四溅掉落在原身眼前。
画面忽转。
原身斜靠在三姑身上，手里拿着小花，看着对面的杨柳飞絮，沐府老妇人陈青云从对面走过来，三姑拉着她行礼。
陈老妇人拉起原身到一间小屋，给她一个包裹，包裹里有盘缠衣物，原身一直抽泣着摇头。
这时沐府小姐从屏风后面走出，拉起原身的手，给她看自己手中的包裹。
原来那是沐府老妇人专门为她们两人准备拜入仙门路上用的物品。
画面又转。
原身独自坐在溪边洗漱脸颊，溪水倒映出一张眼神肃然、身穿红衣、背着长剑、棱角分明的女侠面容。
忽的一束金光，林江月从记忆中醒来，手边温热湿润，是无寐在舔她的手。
赵明玦施法让她站起，并示意无寐后退，随后说道：
“从今天起，林师侄你且记住，每一刻都不要放松炼神术，要让识海中的护盾建立起来就不消散。”
“无寐。”
“真人，我在。”
“你且说说‘惊神刺’。”
“尊令。”
“‘惊神刺’是一项强大的神识攻击法术。提丹田之灵气汇聚神识之中，以意念形成无形尖刺，瞬间攻入对手识海，使对方灵魂受创、陷入失神或震慑状态，在战斗中创造绝佳战机。施展要领在于对神识力量的精纯操控。”
“一般来说神识越是强大，‘惊神刺’的力量也越强大，少数修士因为修为过低、灵力不纯或者专注力不够，无法完全施展。但通过长时间的训练和对战，低阶修士也能使用高阶神识攻击法术。”

“林师妹神识在我之上，在下刚才若不是投机取巧，定无法将师妹刺伤，如有冒犯还请见谅。”
赵明玦见无寐语落，示意林江月凝聚神识之力使出“惊神刺”。
林江月也不犹豫，心中升起战意，快速凝聚脑海神识之力，化成小剑刺了过去。
只见小剑飞跃瞬间便停滞在无寐额前。
无寐手指轻点，小剑落地一声脆响。
接着又说道：“神识之力厉害在于无形，以无形之力潜入敌人脑海，再加以施展。”
赵明玦见林江月不得要领，转而又说。
“林师侄刚才使出的不是神识之力，而是单纯的灵力，只不过……”
那无寐忽而明白，接着赵明玦的话说道。
“恭喜林师妹居然悟出心随意动。”
林江月抬头望向赵明玦。
content_en:
At this time, the buds in Lin Jiangyue's sea of ​​consciousness kept shaking, and fragmented memories kept emerging.
A group of masked monks in black broke into the Mu Mansion to kill and rob. Thunder exploded in the sky and struck down the ancient trees in the courtyard. The ancient trees burst into flames. The fire spread from the trunk to the treetops, and then burned along the corridor pillars to the main house.
A female nun in black was hovering in the air holding two chained swords.
A monk in white clothes rushed into the sea of ​​fire to rescue Miss Mu's family. The female monk in black clothes chased after him, sparks flying in the air and falling in front of his eyes.
The screen suddenly changes.
The original body was leaning against the third aunt, holding a small flower in her hand, looking at the willow catkins opposite, Chen Qingyun, the old woman of Mu Mansion, walked over from the opposite side, and the third aunt pulled her to salute.
Old lady Chen took the original body to a hut and gave her a package containing a bundle of clothes. The original body kept sobbing and shaking her head.
At this time, Miss Mufu walked out from behind the screen, took the original person's hand, and showed her the package in her hand.
It turned out that the old woman of Mu Mansion specially prepared the items for the two of them to use on their way to the Immortal Gate.
The screen changes again.
The original body was sitting alone by the stream washing her cheeks. The stream reflected a sharp-edged face of a heroine wearing red clothes and carrying a long sword with solemn eyes.
Suddenly, with a beam of golden light, Lin Jiangyue woke up from her memory. Her hand was warm and moist, and it was Wumei licking her hand.
Zhao Mingjue cast a spell to make her stand up, signaled Wumei to retreat, and then said:
"From today on, Senior Nephew Lin, please remember not to relax your divine refining skills at any moment, and to establish a shield in the sea of consciousness that will not dissipate."
"No sleep."
"Makoto, I'm here."
"Tell me about the 'Shocking Thorn'."
"Your order."
"'Shocking Spike' is a powerful spiritual attack spell. The aura of the Dantian is gathered into the spiritual consciousness, forming invisible spikes with thoughts, instantly attacking the opponent's sea of consciousness, causing the opponent's soul to be injured, falling into a state of unconsciousness or shock, creating an excellent opportunity in battle. The key to its execution lies in the pure control of the power of spiritual consciousness."
"Generally speaking, the stronger the spiritual consciousness is, the more powerful the 'Shocking Thorn' is. A few monks cannot fully use it due to low cultivation, impure spiritual power or insufficient concentration. However, through long-term training and battles, low-level monks can also use high-level spiritual attack spells."
"Junior Sister Lin's consciousness is higher than mine. If I hadn't been opportunistic just now, I would not have been able to stab Junior Sister. I apologize for any offence."
Seeing Wumei's words fall, Zhao Mingjue signaled Lin Jiangyue to gather the power of her consciousness to use the "Shocking Thorn".
Lin Jiangyue did not hesitate, her fighting spirit arose in her heart, she quickly gathered the power of her consciousness in her mind, turned it into a small sword and stabbed him.
I saw the small sword leaping forward and stopping in front of Wumei's forehead.
Wumei tapped his fingers lightly, and the small sword fell to the ground with a crisp sound.
Then he added: "The power of divine consciousness is invisible. It uses invisible power to sneak into the enemy's mind and then use it."
Seeing that Lin Jiangyue had no idea, Zhao Mingjue turned around and said something else.
"What Junior Nephew Lin used just now was not the power of divine consciousness, but pure spiritual power, but..."
Na Wumei suddenly understood and continued what Zhao Mingjue said.
"Congratulations to Junior Sister Lin for realizing that the mind can move at will."
Lin Jiangyue looked up at Zhao Mingjue.
